name: Egersia
source:
The Queen of Barbaroi, an invader from outer space.  

The purpose of the invasion was to steal “planetary energy” as sustenance, but once Barbaroi was defeated by a magical girl, her purpose and appearance changed.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/suzuha.html]official site[/url]]
